title: Indian and Chinese Thermal Coal Demand Remain Strong
section_path: Indian and Chinese Thermal Coal Demand Remain Strong
section_path_text: Indian and Chinese Thermal Coal Demand Remain Strong
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, dry bulk rates increased across the board last week, with panamax rates rising by the largest amount. Spot coal cargo volume was particularly strong. As we stressed again last week, near-term prospects for Chinese and Indian coal imports are bullish.
